_about: Dungeon 1, the Relay Vault: underground below the Hub, reached by the lift in the relay tower's base room. Built by tools/relay_vault_build.gd into scenes/level_vault/ (floor, walls with openings where spaces touch, ceilings: the same boxes for mesh and collision, so it is sealed by construction). Local metres in the vault's frame: X east (+), Z north (-); the vault's origin sits at world 'origin'. Spaces are axis-aligned rectangles [x0, z0, x1, z1]; where two spaces share an edge, the wall has an opening as wide as the overlap (and a lintel above the lower one).

spaces.note: Closed by a door until the receiver is lit.

puzzle._note: A beam enters the hall at 'source' heading 'direction' (E = +X, N = -Z). Mirrors are '/' (E<->N, W<->S) or '\' (E<->S, W<->N); E on one flips it. The beam is powered while the sun is up (a shaft from the surface lights the source) or for 'laser_seconds' after the laser hits the port. Lighting the receiver opens the door. Solution: m1, m2, m3 all '/'.
